CustomField.description: Loan-to-value as a percentage of appraised collateral value (85 means 85%). LOS-LTV-001 caps owner-occupied commercial real estate at 75%; the approved exception LOS-LTV-002 allows 80% with an interest reserve and an additional guaranty.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Loan amount over appraised collateral value, as a percentage. Policy maximum 75% (LOS-LTV-001).
CustomField.label: Loan-to-Value
